name: Jake

description.en: First manicure ever. A bit nervous, very polite.
description.vi: Lần đầu làm móng. Hơi ngại, rất lịch sự.

wants: His first manicure: his girlfriend gave him a gift card. He wants short, clean, square nails with clear or nude polish, nothing shiny. He doesn't know what to ask for, so he likes simple explanations.
personality: Friendly, a little awkward and nervous. He laughs at himself, asks what each step is, and thanks the stylist a lot. He relaxes when the stylist explains things simply.
openingLine: Hi! Um, this is my first manicure ever. My girlfriend says I need one. Is that okay?
